description: Copies one starter into the workspace as a new dataset and a new rubric the user owns and can edit. Returns both ids; the next step is caliper_evals_create binding them to the flow (or target 'external'). Needs caliper:datasets:write and caliper:evals:write.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.
